column1: # What stock's variant_t answers about a map's text, from the glibc this
# REGENERATE IT INSIDE THE SNIPER CONTAINER, NEVER ON THE HOST. The two
# glibcs disagree, and they disagree here: sscanf("1e", "%f") assigns 1
# under the container's 2.31 and assigns NOTHING under a modern host one,
# so a table generated on the host makes the vector column wrong for every
# truncated exponent. The game and src/buildcpptests both build in the
# container, so the container is the authority.
# Read by BOTH sides, deliberately: variant_convert_test.cpp recomputes
# every column with the real libc, and VariantAgreementTests recomputes
# every column with SourceSharp.Abi.VariantParse. VariantParse is a
# stand-in for native code and a stand-in drifts silently; one table with
# two independent recomputations is what turns the drift into a failure.
